rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Amazon Ads MCP Server provides AI assistants with direct access to the Amazon Advertising API through a Model Context Protocol implementation built by KuudoAI. The server features a pluggable authentication architecture supporting both direct Amazon Ads API credentials and OpenBridge OAuth integration, with automatic OpenAPI specification loading that dynamically generates tools for campaign management, reporting, profile handling, and DSP operations. It includes intelligent response shaping for large AMC datasets, server-side LLM sampling fallback when clients don't support sampling, comprehensive token management with secure storage, and Docker deployment support, making it valuable for advertisers and agencies who need to programmatically manage Amazon advertising campaigns, analyze performance data, and automate reporting workflows through conversational AI interfaces.
